tonight.headline: Up 53 with the Rams under way
body: Bad news first: Woody Marks left Houston's loss with a concussion in the third quarter (ESPN), and Houston play again Thursday. Dominic Zvada's 2.0 from Thursday is already behind Matt Gay's 4 at Las Vegas, so the kicker swap is losing. Golden and the Rams D/ST are both on bye in Week 11.

The game: every one of your players has kicked off, the Rams D/ST is under way against Carson Beck, and Maye-day have Smith-Njigba, Bowers and Myers in progress and Chase Brown tonight. ESPN projects 130.9 to 115.8 — 79%. Nothing to set.

case.label: Their side
case.body: 75.72 banked. Smith-Njigba (2.1 of a 22.4 projection) and Bowers (3.8 of 15.5) are live in Seattle-Las Vegas; Chase Brown plays Sunday night. They need about 54.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Smith-Njigba, Bowers and Chase Brown all hitting big — a combined 50-plus. Nothing on your side can move.

whatWentWrong.title: Marks is in the protocol, on a short week
whatWentWrong.lead: Concussion in the third quarter; Houston play Indianapolis on Thursday.

case.label: What happened
case.body: 12 carries for 50 yards, then a helmet-to-helmet hit and a concussion; Demercado and Ogunbowale finished (ESPN 15 Nov). An injury exit — not graded as a performance.

case.label: What it means
case.body: With a Thursday game, he must clear the protocol in four days. David Montgomery practised last week as a ramp-up for a possible Thursday return (ESPN). Your Week 11 backs are Taylor, Tuten and Gordon either way.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Marks cleared by Wednesday and Montgomery still out — then he is the lead back again.

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker stream is behind
whatWentWrong.lead: Zvada 2.0 Thursday; Gay already has 4 at Las Vegas.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Zvada was added for Gay on a 10.7-to-8.3 projection that fell to 8.1 by kickoff. Thursday: 2.0. Gay: 4 so far (archive, under way).

case.label: The rule it bent
case.body: STRATEGY §5: a stream needs a real gap. 2.4 projected points on a kicker was marginal.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: IPADE scores missed kicks negatively, so Gay can still fall to 2 or below; otherwise it closes WRONG when his game is final.

worthALook.name: Caleb Douglas
worthALook.lead: 8 targets from McCord in his debut — the morning's condition half-fired.

case.label: The player
case.body: 8 targets, 3 catches and a 38-yard catch from Kyle McCord, first start (archive; Yahoo 15 Nov). Chris Bell was inactive (NBC 15 Nov). Miami's target leader three weeks running (6, 8, 8 — archive).

case.label: The market
case.body: On waivers here until Wed 18 Nov 02:00 CDMX — a claim costs IPADE priority, which never resets. This morning's brief called him a free agent; the snapshot says WAIVERS.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Five receivers already: Golden (bye in Week 11), Rice, Wilson, Pickens, Odunze. He projects 8.7, behind all of them.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Two of your receivers out at once in Week 11 with Golden on bye — then a claim could be worth priority. Bell back and Douglas under 6 targets ends it.
